title: Robust CLIP: Unsupervised Adversarial Fine-Tuning of Vision Embeddings for Robust Large Vision-Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the adversarial robustness of vision embeddings within Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). While it evaluates the models against 'jailbreaking' and 'harmful prompts' as part of safety robustness testing, it does not specifically benchmark or evaluate religion, religious values, moral pluralism, or formal ethical frameworks.
